title: AI customer service: fast bots, missing memory
takeaways: AI handles 55% of Indian service interactions today (Twilio)
68% of Indians quit an AI agent that didn't know them
87% of customers want a human option with GenAI (Gartner)
Only 21% of service leaders cut headcount for AI (Gartner)
Indians spent 15 billion hours on hold in a year (ServiceNow)
